items.title: Black Box sees data centre revenue share rising to 30%, explores acquisitions amid strong AI demand
items.description: Black Box expects its data centre revenue share to rise to 30 percent amid strong AI infrastructure demand. With a record order backlog exceeding $1 billion, the company is exploring acquisitions and sees potential to exceed its FY27 growth guidance.

items.description: Brokerage firm Motilal Oswal has maintained a price target of Rs 75 on the stock, indicating an upside of 23 percent from its previous session's closing price.

items.title: Black Box Q2 results: Profit rises 31% to Rs 73 crore, revenue jumps 22%; shares jump 6%
items.description: Black Box Q2 FY27 net profit rose 30.4 percent to Rs 73 crore, while revenue jumped 22.1 percent to Rs 1,936 crore. Shares gained nearly 2 percent as the company reported a record $1.04-billion order backlog and reiterated its FY27 growth guidance.

items.title: Dr Joseph Thomas on Q2 Earnings, Top Sectors & Why Largecaps Rank Above Smallcaps, Midcaps
items.description: Dr Joseph Thomas, Head of Research at Emkay Wealth, breaks down how the Q2 earnings season has played out and what it means for investors from here. He discusses which sectors look attractive for fresh money, how midcap and smallcap earnings have shaped up, and the big question of where to put your money: largecaps, midcaps or smallcaps. He explains why largecaps are his first preference, followed by smallcaps and then midcaps, and why private midcap banks remain a segment he likes. He also shares how his own portfolio is positioned right now. A must-watch for investors trying to balance earnings, sector choices and market-cap allocation.
